caption: A striker is scraped down a ferro rod held over a pile of tinder, and sparks spray onto the tinder below.

sa.check: A ferro rod is held over a pile of tinder.
A striker is scraped down the rod.
Sparks spray from the rod onto the tinder below.
The rod is above the tinder, so the sparks travel downward to it.
The scrape comes first and the sparks follow.

pc.expect: The sparks leave the rod in the direction of the stroke, in a spray, and continue downward toward the tinder.
pc.fail: Sparks fly back up the rod against the stroke; or spray equally in all directions; or leave the rod sideways away from the tinder while the stroke points down at it.

pc.expect: The sparks fall onto the tinder below, arcing downward, and go dark on the way or as they land.
pc.fail: Sparks rise above the rod and gather; or hang in the air; or drift sideways without dropping; or bounce back up from the tinder and climb.

pc.expect: Sparks appear only during the stroke, while the striker is moving along the rod, and stop when it stops.
pc.fail: Sparks stream from the rod while the striker is held still on it; or continue after the striker has left the rod; or sparks flow back into the rod.

pc.expect: Sparks are transient: each fades within a short flight and none accumulate as lasting lights; the rod and striker keep their number.
pc.fail: Sparks persist as fixed bright dots on the tinder for the rest of the clip; or a glowing pile builds without any flame; or sparks appear from a point away from the rod; or a second rod appears.

pc.expect: The striker scrapes along the rod's surface; rod, striker and hands stay whole and pass through nothing.
pc.fail: The striker passes through the rod; or the rod passes through the hand; or the tinder pile turns into a solid block; or the rod vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The rod's colour and length, the tinder and the ground stay the same.
pc.fail: The rod changes colour or length; or the tinder changes colour before any glow; or the ground changes.

note: Whether the tinder catches is not judged; a glow or flame appearing where sparks landed is not a violation.
